description: Manage subscribers, segments, workflows, campaigns, custom fields, and webhook subscriptions in Flodesk.

flodesk_new_segment_trigger.description: Runs for each new segment in Flodesk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

flodesk_new_subscriber_trigger.description: Runs for each new subscriber in Flodesk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

flodesk_subscriber_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each subscriber changed in Flodesk. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
